title: Despegar hotel ratings
description: Three row types share one dataset: hotel (the ratings payload, charged), review (the up-to-four published comments, free) and status (one per target, free).

dataset.title: Despegar hotel ratings
dataset.description: One row per hotel with its score, category scores and AI summary, plus the comments the page publishes and a status row per target. Charged rows are billed as delivered; review and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its filtered, not-found and error tallies, and its HTTP stats.
